## Checklist

- [ ] `python scripts/validate.py` prints `OK`
- [ ] `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` pass (if `app/` changed)
- [ ] No generated study material, scraped catalog data or personal data in the diff
- [ ] Schema and `validate.py` updated together (if a data format changed)
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` updated (if agent behaviour or rules changed)
